scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names BE,FE --prefix-colors yellow,cyan "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:open: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names APP,BROWSER --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && open-cli http://localhost:3000"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test -- --runInBand && npm --prefix backend run test:e2e -- --runInBand
